name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in processing time—depth mapping adds latency—but the quality gain outweighs it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is model hallucination, not resolution—InstantX just sharpens noise. Instead, test RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler in a controlled side-by-side with EXCAVA’s current output; if face fidelity improves by even 0.5%, it’s the better lever.
